@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Susan decided to study b______y at university because she has always loved nature and animals.
= biology
~詞義 biology（n.）生物學
~原文 Susan decided to study biology at university because she has always loved nature and animals.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The prince e______red a beautiful girl in the forest and fell in love with her immediately.
= encountered
~詞義 encounter（v.）碰見
~原文 The prince encountered a beautiful girl in the forest and fell in love with her immediately.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Without her car, Sarah was at the m______y of bus or train schedules, which often made her late for appointments.
= mercy
~詞義 mercy（n.）任由…擺布(be at the mercy of)
~原文 Without her car, Sarah was at the mercy of bus or train schedules, which often made her late for appointments.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The poor woman has suffered from d______n for many years. She always feels unhappy and anxious, which prevents her from living a normal life.
= depression
~詞義 depression（n.）憂鬱症
~原文 The poor woman has suffered from depression for many years. She always feels unhappy and anxious, which prevents her from living a normal life.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The international company plans to establish its headquarters in Singapore because it is considered one of Asia's most important f______l centers.
= financial
~詞義 financial（adj.）財務的;金融的
~原文 The international company plans to establish its headquarters in Singapore because it is considered one of Asia's most important financial centers.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: To pay off her debts, Julia sold everything of value that she ______.
A: neglected
B: appointed
C: constructed
D: possessed
= D
~詞義 possess（v.）擁有
~原文 To pay off her debts, Julia sold everything of value that she possessed.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ is a non-profit organization that collects and distributes clothing to the poor.
A: foundation
B: insurance
C: possession
D: application
= A
~詞義 foundation（n.）基金會
~原文 The foundation is a non-profit organization that collects and distributes clothing to the poor.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is safer to store hot and oily food in glass ______ than in plastic ones.
A: tragedies
B: fictions
C: containers
D: possessions
= C
~詞義 container（n.）容器
~原文 It is safer to store hot and oily food in glass containers than in plastic ones.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The host's joke was ______ for a formal awards ceremony, causing several guests to exchange uncomfortable glances.
A: diligent
B: constructive
C: inappropriate
D: numerous
= C
~詞義 inappropriate（adj.）不適當的
~原文 The host's joke was inappropriate for a formal awards ceremony, causing several guests to exchange uncomfortable glances.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The girl kept ______ at the mosquito bites on her legs.
A: consulting
B: scratching
C: forecasting
D: enclosing
= B
~詞義 scratch（v.）抓
~原文 The girl kept scratching at the mosquito bites on her legs.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: construction
B: comedy
C: diversity
D: appointment
E: scenery
F: anniversary

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: A new bridge that will connect two major cities on either side of the river is currently under ______.
= A
~詞義 construction（n.）建造
~原文 A new bridge that will connect two major cities on either side of the river is currently under construction.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: For their wedding ______, the Wangs plan to have dinner at a fancy restaurant.
= F
~詞義 anniversary（n.）週年紀念日
~原文 For their wedding anniversary, the Wangs plan to have dinner at a fancy restaurant.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Patients must make a(n) ______ in advance to see the doctor because he has a tight schedule.
= D
~詞義 appointment（n.）預約
~原文 Patients must make a(n) appointment in advance to see the doctor because he has a tight schedule.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Fred enjoys ______ because it helps him relax after long study sessions and reminds him not to take things too seriously.
= B
~詞義 comedy（n.）喜劇
~原文 Fred enjoys comedy because it helps him relax after long study sessions and reminds him not to take things too seriously.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Though the island is not very developed, it has beautiful natural ______.
= E
~詞義 scenery（n.）風景
~原文 Though the island is not very developed, it has beautiful natural scenery.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: shelter
B: desperation
C: possession
D: founder
E: reformed
F: overlooked

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The outcome of Randy's experiment was not satisfactory because he ______ an important detail.
= F
~詞義 overlook（v.）忽略
~原文 The outcome of Randy's experiment was not satisfactory because he overlooked an important detail.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The rain came suddenly and we had no umbrellas, so we had to seek ______ from the rain.
= A
~詞義 shelter（n.）遮蔽處
~原文 The rain came suddenly and we had no umbrellas, so we had to seek shelter from the rain.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: In his ______ to finish the project, George skipped meals and stayed awake far longer than was healthy.
= B
~詞義 desperation（n.）不顧一切地冒險;破釜沉舟
~原文 In his desperation to finish the project, George skipped meals and stayed awake far longer than was healthy.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: As the ______ of the company, Ken has led his employees through all kinds of difficulties.
= D
~詞義 founder（n.）創辦者
~原文 As the founder of the company, Ken has led his employees through all kinds of difficulties.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: That painting came into Sara's ______ last week when she bought it at a gallery.
= C
~詞義 possession（n.）擁有
~原文 That painting came into Sara's possession last week when she bought it at a gallery.
